correctness.rationale: Ultrahomogeneity reduces unary orbits to pointed one-generated subalgebras. Nishimura/Citkin classify those pointed algebras, including the exceptional generator pairs. Strong amalgamation over the two-element constants algebra produces arbitrarily many distinct realizations of each nonconstant pointed type, proving every O_n is infinite; countability makes it countably infinite.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural description of the natural point action of a studied non-omega-categorical homogeneous algebra. It strengthens the qualitative fact that the automorphism group is non-oligomorphic by locating the failure already in arity one and giving exact orbit invariants and cardinalities; it is not a parameter tweak or finite recomputation.
